cards.example_en: The hotel's rating fell after a noisy weekend.
cards.example_zh: 吵闹的周末过后，这家旅馆的评分下降了。

cards.example_en: Don't eat the fish raw.
cards.example_zh: 鱼不要生吃。

cards.example_en: A ray of sun came through the window.
cards.example_zh: 一缕阳光透过窗户。

cards.example_en: How did the class react to the news?
cards.example_zh: 班上对这个消息有什么反应？

cards.example_en: A big smile was her reaction to the surprise cake.
cards.example_zh: 面对惊喜蛋糕，她的反应是灿烂一笑。

cards.example_en: A realistic plan includes time for homework and rest.
cards.example_zh: 一个现实的计划会包含写作业和休息的时间。

cards.example_en: Camp felt colder in reality than it looked in photos.
cards.example_zh: 野营的现实感觉比照片里更冷。

cards.example_en: Can you recall where we left the picnic blanket?
cards.example_zh: 你能回忆起我们把野餐毯落在哪儿了吗？

cards.example_en: Can I have a receipt, please?
cards.example_zh: 请给我开个收据，好吗？

cards.example_en: I saw her recently at school.
cards.example_zh: 我最近在学校见过她。

cards.example_en: The receptionist gave us a map.
cards.example_zh: 接待员给了我们一张地图。

cards.example_en: This recipe needs two eggs.
cards.example_zh: 这个食谱需要两个鸡蛋。

cards.example_en: Please recite the poem from memory.
cards.example_zh: 请把这首诗背出来。

cards.example_en: He received recognition for his singing after the concert.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会后，他的歌唱得到了承认。

cards.example_en: We played the recording of our class choir at home.
cards.example_zh: 我们在家里播放了班级合唱团的录音。

cards.example_en: It took him a week to recover from that bad cold.
cards.example_zh: 他过了一周才从那场重感冒中恢复过来。

cards.example_en: The park is a place for recreation.
cards.example_zh: 公园是娱乐的地方。

cards.example_en: Always refer to the map if you miss the turning.
cards.example_zh: 如果错过路口，一定要查阅地图。

cards.example_en: I keep this atlas as a reference for geography homework.
cards.example_zh: 我留着这本地图册，当作地理作业的参考。

cards.example_en: His diary may reflect how he felt during exams.
cards.example_zh: 他的日记也许反映了他考试期间的心情。

cards.example_en: The school reform started last year.
cards.example_zh: 学校改革从去年开始。

cards.example_en: A cold drink will refresh you.
cards.example_zh: 一杯冷饮能让你提神。

cards.example_en: I regard my coach as a patient and honest person.
cards.example_zh: 我把教练看作一个耐心又诚实的人。

cards.example_en: We will go regardless.
cards.example_zh: 不管怎样我们都会去。

cards.example_en: Visitors come to this region for sweet apples and clean rivers.
cards.example_zh: 游客为了甜苹果和清澈的河流来到这个地方。

cards.example_en: New students register at the office on the first day.
cards.example_zh: 新生第一天到办公室登记。

cards.example_en: Regular exercise helps you sleep better at night.
cards.example_zh: 有规律的锻炼能帮助你晚上睡得更好。

cards.example_en: They did not reject his idea.
cards.example_zh: 他们没有拒绝他的想法。

cards.example_en: These photos relate to our trip last summer.
cards.example_zh: 这些照片与我们去年夏天的旅行有关。

cards.example_en: Our class won the relay.
cards.example_zh: 我们班赢了接力赛。

cards.example_en: The zoo will release the healed bird next Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 动物园将在下星期六释放那只痊愈的鸟。

cards.example_en: Please include all relevant information.
cards.example_zh: 请提供所有相关信息。

cards.example_en: My old car isn't very reliable.
cards.example_zh: 我的旧车不太可靠。

cards.example_en: The medicine brought relief from his bad headache.
cards.example_zh: 这药缓解了他那厉害的头痛。

cards.example_en: Hikers rely on a paper map when phones lose signal.
cards.example_zh: 手机没有信号时，徒步的人依靠纸质地图。

cards.example_en: Her remarkable memory lets her recall every classmate's birthday.
cards.example_zh: 她的记忆力了不起，能记住每位同学的生日。

cards.example_en: The remote village has no shop and one small school.
cards.example_zh: 那个偏远的村子没有商店，只有一所小学校。

cards.example_en: Remove the broken chair from the classroom aisle.
cards.example_zh: 把那把坏椅子从教室过道里搬走。

cards.example_en: We moved to a smaller flat when the rent increased.
cards.example_zh: 租金上涨以后，我们搬进了更小的公寓。

cards.example_en: We should replace the cracked window before winter.
cards.example_zh: 入冬之前我们应该换掉那扇裂了的窗户。

cards.example_en: Two students represent our class at the city forum.
cards.example_zh: 两名学生在城市论坛上代表我们班。

cards.example_en: Each class chose one representative for the student council.
cards.example_zh: 每个班为学代会选了一名代表。

cards.example_en: France is a republic.
cards.example_zh: 法国是共和国。

cards.example_en: The school has a good reputation.
cards.example_zh: 这所学校名声很好。

cards.example_en: She made a request for more time.
cards.example_zh: 她请求再给一些时间。

cards.example_en: The fishermen were rescued by helicopter.
cards.example_zh: 渔民被直升机救起。

cards.example_en: We reserve the front seats for visiting parents.
cards.example_zh: 我们为来访的家长保留前排座位。

cards.example_en: Every resident on our street recycled glass last month.
cards.example_zh: 上个月，我们这条街上的每位居民都回收了玻璃。

cards.example_en: The coach decided to resign.
cards.example_zh: 教练决定辞职。

cards.example_en: The plan met strong resistance.
cards.example_zh: 这个计划遇到了强烈反对。

word.example_en: This pronoun can refer to the whole class.
In regard to fees, please ask the office.
With regard to homework, ask Ms Chen.
word.example_zh: 对于作业问题，请问陈老师。

word.example_en: Join the choir regardless of your score.
word.example_zh: 不论分数如何，都可以加入合唱团。

word.example_en: The chart is relevant to the question.
Do not rely on a single source.
